notes.title: Important Update: Our Game's New Name - Windwoven!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have an important update regarding our upcoming game, previously known as Windblown Land.

Why the Change?
We recently received a legal notice concerning potential trademark conflicts with our original game name, Windblown Land. After careful consideration and consultation, we’ve decided to change our game’s English name to Windwoven to resolve this matter and avoid potential confusion or legal complications moving forward.

What Does This Mean?

Development Continues! This is only a name change. Our vision, gameplay, and development roadmap remain completely unaffected.

New Identity, Same Spirit: Windwoven reflects the game’s core themes of wind, nature, and interconnected stories. We believe it captures the essence of our world even more beautifully.

Steam Page Updates: You’ll see Windwoven replacing Windblown Land across our Steam page, logo, and assets soon. Bookmarks and wishlists will automatically update.

Our Commitment to You:
We understand name changes can be surprising. Rest assured:

This decision was made to protect the game and our team’s future.

We’re more motivated than ever to deliver an unforgettable experience.

Your continued support means the world to us. Thank you for sticking with us!

What’s Next?
Keep an eye out for Windwoven! We’ll share more updates, art, and gameplay as development progresses. This new name marks an exciting chapter, and we can’t wait to share it with you.

Thank you for your understanding and enthusiasm,
The Candybit Team
